statement: For every r>=2 a specified Fermat-cubic cone of local dimension2r has an infinite-order ordinary restriction kernel for its coordinate hyperplane puncture
depends_on: C.3r elliptic Fermat correspondence and Abel-Jacobi non-support; C.3e strict-cone injection; explicit rational cubic surface
notes: The restricted family factors through CH0 of the Fermat cubic surface, which is Z integrally. The source class uses the same specified transcendental elliptic point as C3r.
